title: AiOffer
description: ai.offer@1: one community AI offer, a person's machine (OpenVibe Link's ai plugin, "Offer to the network") serving its local models to requests that opt in to community capacity. OpenVibe.Bot reports these fields (POST /internal/ai/offers/report on Network, network.resource.report; a report with any other field is refused whole), and OpenVibe.AI reads them from Network (GET /internal/ai/offers, network.registry.read, { offers, generated_at, count }). Network adds `pool` (ai.offer-pool@1) to the head's offer when the machine is the head of an approved pool (bot.machine-pool@1), and leaves a pool member's own offer out of the list while it is in a pool. For a pool the hours, audience, price, readiness, idle-only and verification apply to the whole pool: it is ready only while every member has approved, renewed its readiness in the last few seconds, and is still the owner's. Nothing here is public: AI shows Exchange a hashed offer id and no owner or machine id.

machine_id.description: The machine that answers (for a pool, its head).

owner.description: The machine's owner, who earns the offer's credits (a self-served run earns none).

models.description: The models offered, as the machine's model server names them.

hours.description: The local-time window the offer is open; start equal to end is all day, and an overnight window wraps.

tz.description: An IANA time zone, such as Europe/Paris, or UTC.

concurrency.description: How many requests may run at once; another is refused as busy, never queued.

price.description: Credits per million input and output tokens; 0 and 0 is a volunteer, who earns kudos. One price for a pool.

audience.description: Who may use it: everyone, the owner's followers, or one group (`group`).

group.description: The group's id when the audience is `group`, otherwise null.

ready.description: Whether the machine (for a pool, every member) can answer now: online, inside its hours, not paused by idle-only or a kill switch.

pool.description: Present when the offer is served by a pool of the owner's machines (ai.offer-pool@1).
